details.warfarin_alert_effect: CYP2C9 inhibition of S-warfarin clearance sharply raises INR; bleeding risk.

warfarin_alert_severity_moderate_or_high.note: Warfarin+fluconazole is a documented moderate/severe co-administration interaction.

warfarin_clearance_modifier.note: CYP2C9 inhibition reduces warfarin clearance; expected reported AUC fold-change ~2-3 (moderate DDI).

reference.note: Jones HM & Rowland-Yeo K. Clin Pharmacol Syst Pharmacol 2013;2:e43. CYP2C9 inhibition by fluconazole raises warfarin AUC/exposure; moderate co-administration interaction.
reference.source: CYP inhibition DDI mechanism and typical AUC-fold-change ranges (warfarin + fluconazole)
